nodes.name: Google Drive Trigger
nodes.notes: Watches a Google Drive folder for new PDF resumes. Replace 'YOUR_GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID' with your folder ID.

parameters.name: job_description
parameters.value: ={{ $json.job_description || 'Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 3+ years React and Python experience, familiar with cloud deployments and REST APIs.' }}

nodes.name: Screen Candidate
nodes.notes: Calls POST /api/hire/screen with resume file + job description. Returns score, shortlist flag, skills_found, github_data.

nodes.name: Generate Screening Questions
nodes.notes: Calls POST /api/hire/generate-questions with resume text + JD. Returns 3 custom technical questions.

nodes.name: Log to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Calls POST /api/hire/log-to-sheets to record candidate result. Works in mock mode if Sheets creds not configured.

nodes.name: Shortlisted?
nodes.notes: Only send WhatsApp alert if candidate is shortlisted (score >= 70).

nodes.name: WhatsApp Alert (Mock)
nodes.notes: MOCK WhatsApp node. Replace with: Twilio, 360dialog, or WhatsApp Business API node. Message includes score, skills, and generated questions.

nodes.name: Not Shortlisted
nodes.notes: Handles candidates who scored below 70. Logs for record keeping.

_comment.workflow_description: HireMind n8n Workflow: Google Drive Trigger -> Screen Candidate -> Generate Questions -> Log to Sheets -> WhatsApp Alert
setup_instructions: 1. Import this JSON into n8n via Workflows > Import from File
2. Set your Google Drive folder ID in the trigger node
3. Update the backend URL (localhost:8000) to your deployed URL
4. Set SHEET_ID and GOOGLE_CRED_JSON in your backend .env for real Sheets logging
5. Replace the WhatsApp Mock node with a real Twilio/360dialog node
6. Add job_description as a static value or pull it from a Sheets row
